description: This file contains test implementations and mocks for managing Kubernetes object fields, including fake object creators, converters, defaulters, and a test field manager implementation used for testing field management logic in Kubernetes API machinery.

classes.name: FakeObjectCreater
classes.description: A mock object creator that creates empty unstructured objects with specified GVK.

classes.name: FakeObjectConvertor
classes.description: A mock object convertor that performs no actual conversion, returning input as output.

classes.name: FakeObjectDefaulter
classes.description: A mock defaulter that does nothing.

classes.name: TestFieldManagerImpl
classes.description: A test implementation of a field manager for Kubernetes objects, supporting apply, update, reset, and retrieval of managed fields.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new unstructured object with specified GVK.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Performs no conversion, returns input as output.

methods.name: ConvertFieldLabel
methods.description: Returns an error indicating not implemented.

methods.name: APIVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version of the tracked object.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the live object to an empty state.

methods.name: Live
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the current live object.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a new object on top of the current live object.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the managed fields in the live object.

methods.name: ManagedFields
methods.description: Retrieves the managed fields of the live object.
